description: This file defines the class Opencart.Catalog.Model.Cms.Antispam, which extends a system engine model and provides functionality related to detecting spam comments. The class includes a method getSpam that checks if a comment contains spam keywords stored in the database.

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: A model class for spam detection within the CMS component of the OpenCart Catalog module.

methods.name: getSpam
methods.description: Checks if the provided comment contains spam keywords by querying the database for matches.
